findings.message: The `prefs` cookie is fully controlled by the client and is passed to `pickle.loads`, so anyone can send a crafted pickle and run arbitrary code on the server. Store the preferences as JSON (or a signed value) instead of a pickle.

When the request has no `prefs` cookie the default is an empty string, and `pickle.loads(b"")` raises `EOFError`, so first-time visitors get a server error instead of the `light` theme. Malformed cookies crash the handler the same way.
The new `preferences` handler adds behaviour but the pull request adds no test for it.
